scorecard.method: next open entry, reference stop, no fees

regimes.up: Uptrend: BTC above its 200-day average and at least half of the liquid coins above theirs
regimes.down: Downtrend: BTC below its 200-day average and fewer than 40% of the liquid coins above theirs

top_w_div.label: Possible major top (weekly)
top_w_div.text: Weekly RSI bearish divergence at a 26-week high: price made a higher high while weekly RSI, overbought (above 70) on the earlier peak, made a lower high.

top_d_div.label: Possible top (daily)
top_d_div.text: Daily RSI bearish divergence at a 90-day high: a new high on weaker momentum, the earlier peak overbought (RSI above 70).

bottom_d_div.label: Possible bottom (daily)
bottom_d_div.text: Daily RSI bullish divergence at a 90-day low: a new low on stronger momentum, the earlier low oversold (RSI below 30).

hs_top.label: Head and shoulders top (daily)
hs_top.text: A completed head-and-shoulders top: three swing highs with the middle one highest, shoulders of similar height, after a rise into the pattern; the setup is the first daily close below the neckline (within 30 days of the right shoulder). Invalid above the right shoulder; measured target = neckline minus the pattern height.

bottom_breakout.label: Bottom accumulation breakout
bottom_breakout.text: After a fall of 80%+ from the 2-year high, a tight 60-day base (high no more than 1.5x the low), then the first close above the base on at least 2x normal volume. On its own close to a coin flip since 2022; strong when many coins do it at once (see the 14-day count).

accum_breakout.label: Accumulation breakout
accum_breakout.text: First close above a contained 90-day range (high no more than 2x the low) on at least 2x normal volume.
